sc: It can be obtained by either exchanging pizazz points at the Mage Training Arena, buying one from another player or purchasing it from the Grand Exchange.
The barrows-dyed augmented drygore mace is a level 90 Melee main hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Drygore mace (Barrows), or by using Barrows dye on an augmented drygore mace.
The augmented Saradomin sword is a tier 75 melee two-handed weapon created by using an augmentor on a Saradomin sword.
The Aurora Off-Hand Battleaxe is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that was unlocked by completing tier 6 of the Wintumber Aurora Yak Track with the premier pass.

Bandos armour set.x: A Bandos armour set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items from Bandos equipment with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface. Its components are dropped by monsters in the God Wars Dungeon and require level 70 Defence to wear.

Battle Robes (Fumus) Legs.x: Battle Robes (Fumus) Legs is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Battle Robes (Fumus) set.

sc: It was possible to obtain the blood ethereal legs from Treasure Hunter on 17 October 2014, and from 19 October 2014 to 20 October 2014.
They can also be created from 3,600 rune ethereal fragments with level 80 Runecrafting and 20 Invention.

sc: Bryll shoes is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
It is made by using class 4 sacred clay with a creation kiln.
Chaos witch's wand is an item that can be dug up on the of Daemonheim castle after following a series of cryptic instructions found in the sunken box recovered in the Garden of Kharid.
The wand resembles those used by various chaos witches found in The Zamorakian Undercity.

Varrock south-west mine is also close to a bank (members only) at May's Quest Caravan once the bank chest is unlocked from the Hub track for a cumulative cost of 125 quest points.
sc: Copper ore is an ore that can be obtained through mining copper rocks, requiring level 1 Mining, in various places around RuneScape.
The corpsethorn shortbow is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Fletching skill.
A cracked woodcutting urn (empty) is an urn created by using an earth rune on a cracked woodcutting urn (no rune), requiring level 4 Crafting.

sc: Crypt scythe token is a token which could be won from Treasure Hunter during the Boneyard promotion.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Crypt Scythe override, destroying the token.
They can be purchased from Angof's Crystal Armour Shop for 100 Tarddian crystals.

Dagon'hai robes set.x: Dagon'hai robes set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

Death Bringer Gloves.x: The Death Bringer Gloves are a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Death Bringer Vestments outfit. They can be unlocked by purchasing the Death Reaper Vestments Set. They are an upgraded version of the Death Seeker Gloves, unlocked by completing 10 Slayer assignments while having any Death Seeker cosmetic active.

Elf-style dress top (black).x: The black elf-style dress top is part of the elven outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Golden trout eggs are a reward from Fishing, fishing trout, used in the Aquarium of a player-owned house.

Ilujankan Fighter's Maul is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 16 of the Journey to Iaia Yak Track with the premier pass.
Ilujankan Fighter's Spear is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 11 of the Journey to Iaia Yak Track.

Invictum Scimitar.x: The Invictum Scimitar is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that is part of the Invictum Outfit. Along with the rest of the outfit, it can be unlocked by spending 100% respect in the Artisans' Workshop.

sc: A medium dungeoneering token box is an item that could be obtained from Treasure Hunter on 8 December 2015, or later from various sources (e.
It was made by upgrading a strong slayer helmet for 600 Slayer points at any Slayer Master, although subsequent upgrades would only cost 60 Slayer points.
The helm could hold a maximum of 30 ferocious ring charges and 40 ring of slaying charges, made by using the rings on the helmet and requiring 60 Crafting.
Mind boots are an elemental pair of boots that can be made after completion of the quest Elemental Workshop IV.
It can be made out of two necronium bars at level 70 Smithing, and can be added to the tool belt or removed from it.
Novite ore is an ore that can be obtained through mining novite rocks, requiring level 100 Mining, on the surface of the Daemonheim peninsula.
It can be purchased from Marmaros the rewards trader for 1,000,000 dungeoneering tokens ( with the warped gorajan trailblazer outfit) and 1 warped stone, and comes with its main hand variant.

sc: A rune ingot (heated) is made by heating a rune ingot IV in a furnace in the main area of the Artisans' Workshop, while having tongs in the inventory.
It can be obtained on the floor of the cave below the Mage Arena, just south-east of the ritual marker.
Once obtained, it can be searched to obtain one measly fire rune.
It is obtained by searching the nearby equipment box on starting the performance.
Silver spines are Fletching materials received as drops from Silverquill, the Dreadhog.
Sleigher Armour is a cosmetic override outfit available from the Christmas Spirit Shop for 5,000 Christmas Spirit.
Smithing XP lamp is an experience lamp awarded upon completion of Heroes' Quest.
It was made by combining a gold charm with 8 spirit shards and a Spider carcass.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to Runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 1 steel bar, requiring 300 progress to complete, granting a total of 75 Smithing experience.
Steel boots were members-only until the 5 October 2015 update, when it was made possible for free-to-play to obtain them by trading with members.

Steel Panther.x: Steel Panther is a pet that can be unlocked by claiming the founder's pack after taking part in the early access RuneScape Mobile release.
